method: Closed finite object lifting a check to all lengths or continuations
target_statement: For every K, some finite B(K) bounds repeats uniformly over all originals with Q_2 <= K.

precondition_1_fixed_finite_state_space_.reason: The target statement quantifies universally over K in N. The capped-count language recognizer state space grows strictly with K (74 product states at K=17, 147 product states at K=32), and no finite automaton or transducer can represent the union of all capacity classes.

precondition_2_bounded_parameter_dimensi.reason: The second bulk output families have an unbounded number of free repetition parameters (1 parameter at K<=17, 2 parameters at K=18, m parameters at length 5+5m). A closed finite object only lifts over 1-dimensional length/continuation at fixed width/family.

precondition_3_closure_at_next_step_k18.reason: Even if restricted to individual K, at the first open capacity K=18, the closed finite object method failed: joint column state sets hit the 2,000,000-state memory cap at depths 12-16 without closing. Witnesses live to depth N=35, D=22, requiring certificate depth d >= 34, which is beyond finite tractability (~10^14 states).

verdict.failing_precondition: Precondition 1 (fixed finite state space for the universally quantified scope) and Precondition 2 (bounded parameter dimension of boundary families) both fail. The target quantifies over all K in N, while a closed finite object only lifts over length at a fixed width or family.
verdict.recommendation: Stop per instruction: do not adapt the method until it stops being the method.
